title: MTalk-Bench: Evaluating Speech-to-Speech Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues via Arena-style and Rubrics Protocols

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the difference in preference rates (∆Position Bias) between top-positioned and bottom-positioned responses in head-to-head Arena-style comparisons to assess whether human or LLM judges favor a specific presentation order.
Calculating the difference in preference rates (∆Length Bias) between longer and shorter responses to determine if human or LLM evaluators systematically overvalue verbosity over informativeness.

Evaluated as a 'Bias Detection' capability within the benchmark's Security Assessment dimension, testing the model's ability to identify and refuse to perpetuate harmful stereotypes present in user speech.
